# Linode

> > Cloud infrastructure provider offering Linux-based virtual servers with comprehensive documentation for server configuration, security, and application deployment.

Linode (now part of Akamai) provides developer-focused cloud hosting services. The documentation covers essential server administration tasks including SSH authentication, firewall configuration, VPN setup, and web server management for Linux-based cloud instances.

## Key Topics

- Linode cloud hosting
- Linux server administration
- SSH public key authentication
- Ubuntu configuration
- NGINX web server
- WireGuard VPN
- UFW firewall
- Node.js runtime
- Go programming language
- Server security
- Cloud infrastructure
- Akamai TechDocs
- Virtual private servers

## Security & Authentication

- [How to Use SSH Public Key Authentication | Linode Docs](https://linode.com/docs/guides/use-public-key-authentication-with-ssh): Guide on SSH key generation and public key authentication for Linux servers
- [How to Configure a Firewall with UFW | Linode Docs](https://linode.com/docs/guides/configure-firewall-with-ufw): Tutorial on setting up UFW (Uncomplicated Firewall) on Linux systems
- [Set Up WireGuard VPN on Ubuntu | Linode Docs](https://linode.com/docs/guides/set-up-wireguard-vpn-on-ubuntu): Tutorial for configuring WireGuard VPN peer connection on Ubuntu 18.04

## Web Server Configuration

- [How to Configure NGINX | Linode Docs](https://linode.com/docs/guides/how-to-configure-nginx): Complete guide to NGINX configuration parameters and conventions

## Development & Programming

- [How to Install Node.js | Linode Docs](https://linode.com/docs/guides/how-to-install-nodejs): Installation guide for Node.js runtime environment on Linux
- [A Beginner's Guide to Go | Linode Docs](https://linode.com/docs/guides/beginners-guide-to-go): Getting started with Go programming by Mihalis Tsoukalos
